title: Greek Baked Cod
description: A flavorful and healthy Greek-inspired baked cod recipe, perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or aluminum foil.
Place the cod fillets on the prepared baking sheet.
Drizzle the kissed olive oil over the cod fillets.
Sprinkle the Greek seasoning over the cod fillets.
Drizzle the lemon juice over the cod fillets.
Sprinkle the minced garlic over the cod fillets.
Bake in the preheated oven for 8-10 minutes, or until the cod is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley, if desired.
